encoded.overflow: not truncated; maxDigit only controls prepended zero count
encoded.shrink_content_rule: decrement integer font size only while shaped run width exceeds serialized widget width 188; eight digits remain 28, nine-digit 009000000 begins at 27

rank.prohibition: Serialized rank-root x values are prefab placeholders; C/B/A/S/SS must each be overwritten by CalculateScoreReachObjectPositionX during SetupRankObject.

ss.trigger: Score.onChangedScoreGaugeRank only when the rank changes to SS (5), SSS (6), or original mode 12 branch; ordinary score updates inside the same rank do not restart the Animator.
ss.prohibition: Do not restart ScoreGaugeSS on every Score.UpdateView/reflect. The 3-second looping clip advances continuously after one rank-transition trigger.

rootFlash.owner: one slide-head slideNoteFlashAnimator/Sprite only; NoteSlideAfter owns no flash component
rootFlash.placement: The flash is a child of the Slide root. The root remains at the judgement line after head judgement while current NoteSlideAfter nodes advance; the flash is not attached to each authored intermediate node.

mesh.visibility: Segments are projected from launcher through target; a product graph must not clip every segment to the lower half or derive expected vertices from its own production helper.

lifecycle.ordering: Touch Began and successful judgement may retrigger Idle; judgement calls On then OffReserve in one outer frame. Counter 2 is consumed by that same outer update and the next outer update enters AnimatedOff; retrigger restarts Idle. Touch Ended calls AnimatedOff directly.

worldComposition.ownerParent: exact GamePlayButton Transform selected by the note caller
worldComposition.systemLocal: serialized ParticleSystem Transform followed by every serialized parent Transform
worldComposition.camera: orthographic world point = GamePlayButton anchor + emitted system-parent-chain point; Pixi top-left projection is x=viewport/2+worldX*height/2 and y=height/2-worldY*height/2
worldComposition.sorting: ParticleSystemRenderer sortingOrder, then system identity and creation sequence; lane sortingOrder 0 remains below particle orders 1/5/50

scalePipeline.first_pass: each child ParticleSystem Transform.localScale XYZ *= screenWidthAdjustRate
scalePipeline.second_pass: the same child ParticleSystem Transform.localScale XYZ *= normalizedNoteSize * ScreenToSafeAreaRatio
scalePipeline.enumeration: GetComponentsInChildren<ParticleSystem>(includeInactive=true) under every integer and half GamePlayButton
scalePipeline.mutated_property: each ParticleSystem component own Transform.localScale only
scalePipeline.nested_semantics: every ParticleSystem component in an ancestor chain receives g; child local position is scaled by particle-system ancestors while emitted shape position, velocity and billboard size also consume the emitting system own g
scalePipeline.final_world_semantics: compose each serialized TRS after multiplying that ParticleSystem transform scale by g; do not flatten the completed world sample to one final g

scalingModeCorrection.button_manager_mutation: g multiplies every ParticleSystem Transform localScale
scalingModeCorrection.emission_position_and_velocity: compose emitting child and ParticleSystem ancestor TRS; nested child world offsets retain g per ParticleSystem transform
scalingModeCorrection.billboard_size: ParticleSystemScalingMode.Local consumes the emitting ParticleSystem own local scale and does not multiply parent ParticleSystem scale into particle size
scalingModeCorrection.billboard_orientation: compose root-to-component rotations while parent scale is excluded from Local size magnitude

terminal.lifecycle: Natural BGM end enters GameClearAnimStart (11), plays the base clear graph plus the clear-status additional graph, waits for RhythmGameClearAnimController.ClearAnimationFinished, enters GameClearAnimEnd (12), and only then begins onExit.
